## Component and version

Identify the documentation commit or installed component. For a client connection, include the client and runtime versions. For a native claim, state the exact recipe and engine version if that capability is available in your release.

## Expected behavior

What did you expect this supported feature to do?

## Actual result

What happened? Include the non-sensitive error code and whether an operation actually launched, if known.

## Minimal reproduction

List the smallest steps and use an owned synthetic example where possible. Describe the inspected scope and relevant changes since the last successful result.

## Reviewed evidence

Include a small sanitized export only if useful. Do not post credentials, private endpoints, full server logs, player data, private project archives, or third-party assets. Use SECURITY.md for a sensitive security finding.
